items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: I was acquainted with Fats, and he wanted me to come in on the band for awhile. I did, I did about three or four weeks down there with him

ctx.x: Yeah. But he could play, though, and entertain. Fats Waller was great, he was great, he was great.
What year was this, when you were called by Fats?
